## Import data
```{r}
library(plyr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(arsenal)
counts <- read.delim("data/counts.tsv", sep = "\t")
genes <- read.delim("data/genes.tsv", sep = "\t")
samples <- read.delim("data/samples.tsv", sep = "\t")
tpms <- read.delim("data/tpms.tsv", sep = "\t")
```

## Examine Datasets
```{r}
dim(counts)
str(counts)
anyNA(counts)
sum(duplicated(counts))

dim(genes)
str(genes)
table(genes$chromosome)
anyNA(genes)
sum(duplicated(genes))

dim(samples)
str(samples)
anyNA(samples)
sum(duplicated(samples))

dim(tpms)
str(tpms)
anyNA(tpms)
sum(duplicated(tpms))

comparedf(genes, counts, by = "flybase_gene_id")
comparedf(genes, tpms, by = "flybase_gene_id")


sum(counts$control_rep1 < 0, counts$control_rep2 < 0, counts$msl2_rep1 < 0, counts$msl2_rep2<0, counts$mof_rep1 <0, counts$mof_rep2 < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(tpms$control_rep1 < 0, tpms$control_rep2 < 0, tpms$msl2_rep1 < 0, tpms$msl2_rep2<0, tpms$mof_rep1 <0, tpms$mof_rep2 < 0, na.rm = TRUE)


```

## Creat SummarizedExperiment
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
counts <- counts%>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="flybase_gene_id")
str(counts)
counts <- as.matrix(counts)

tpms <- tpms%>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="flybase_gene_id")
str(tpms)
tpms <- as.matrix(tpms)

genes <- genes %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var = "flybase_gene_id")
samples <- samples %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id")

sum(rownames(counts) %in% rownames(tpms))
sum(rownames(genes) %in% rownames(counts))

se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts, tpms = tpms), rowData = genes, colData = samples)

```
## Heuristic Analysis
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(datarium)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
tpms_plot <- assay(se, "tpms")
tpms_plot <- as.data.frame(tpms_plot)
tpms_plot <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tpms_plot, var = "flybase_gene_id")
tpms_longer <- pivot_longer(tpms_plot, cols = 2:7, names_to = "condition", values_to = "tpms")

ggplot(data = tpms_longer, mapping = aes(x = condition, y = log10(tpms+1)))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08,
              height = 0)+
  labs(title = "Difference between Various Conditions", x = "conditions", y = "log10 tpms")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = tpms_longer, mapping = aes(x=log10(tpms+1), colour = condition, fill = condition))+
  geom_density(bw = 0.2, alpha = 0.05)+
  labs(title = "Distribution of Tpms on Various Conditions ")+
  theme_minimal()

tpms_cor <- assay(se, "tpms")
tpms_cor <- cor(tpms_cor)
HeatMap <- heatmap(tpms_cor, scale = "none", symm = TRUE, margins = c(8,8)) 

```

## Compare msl2 and mof RNAi with the Control Condition
```{r}
counts_plot <- assay(se, "counts")
counts_plot <- as.data.frame(counts_plot)
counts_plot <- tibble::rownames_to_column(counts_plot, var = "flybase_gene_id")
counts_longer1 <- pivot_longer(counts_plot, cols = 2:5, names_to = "condition", values_to = "counts")
counts_longer2 <- pivot_longer(counts_plot, cols = c("control_rep1", "control_rep2", "mof_rep1", "mof_rep2"), names_to = "condition", values_to = "counts")
ggplot(data = counts_longer1, mapping = aes(x= condition, y=log10(counts+1)))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08,
              height = 0)+
  labs(title = "Comparison between Control and msl2 RNAi Conditions", x ="Conditions", y="Counts")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = counts_longer1, mapping = aes(x=log10(counts+1), group = condition, fill = condition))+
  geom_density(bw = 0.4, alpha = 0.4)+
  labs(title = "Distribution of Control and mls2 RNAi Conditions")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = counts_longer2, mapping = aes(x= condition, y=log10(counts+1)))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08,
              height = 0)+
  labs(title = "Comparison between Control and mof RNAi Conditions", x ="Conditions", y="Counts")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = counts_longer2, mapping = aes(x=log10(counts+1), group = condition, fill = condition))+
  geom_density(bw = 0.4, alpha = 0.4)+
  labs(title = "Distribution of Control and mof RNAi Conditions")+
  theme_minimal()
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

library(DESeq2)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = samples, design = ~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
results1 <- results(dds)
results1
results2 <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition","mof", "control"))
results2

results1 <- as.data.frame(results1)
results1 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(results1, var = "flybase_gene_id")
results2 <- as.data.frame(results2)
results2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(results2, var = "flybase_gene_id")

genes_com <- rowData(se, use.names = TRUE)
genes_com <- as.data.frame(genes_com)
genes_com <- tibble::rownames_to_column(genes_com, var = "flybase_gene_id")

base::nrow(genes_com)
base::nrow(results1)
base::names(genes_com)
base::names(results1)
base::length(base::unique(genes_com$flybase_gene_id))
base::length(base::unique(results1$flybase_gene_id))
results1_com <- dplyr::left_join(x= genes_com, y= results1, by= "flybase_gene_id" )

base::nrow(genes_com)
base::nrow(results2)
base::names(genes_com)
base::names(results2)
base::length(base::unique(genes_com$flybase_gene_id))
base::length(base::unique(results2$flybase_gene_id))
results2_com <- dplyr::left_join(x= genes_com, y= results2, by= "flybase_gene_id" )

sum(is.na(results1_com$log2FoldChange))
sum(is.na(results1_com$pvalue))
sum(is.na(results1_com$lfcSE))
sum(is.na(results1_com$stat))
sum(is.na(results1_com$padj))

sum(is.na(results2_com$log2FoldChange))
sum(is.na(results2_com$pvalue))
sum(is.na(results2_com$lfcSE))
sum(is.na(results2_com$stat))
sum(is.na(results2_com$padj))

results1_com_cle <- filter(results1_com, !is.na(results1_com$log2FoldChange))
results2_com_cle <- filter(results2_com, !is.na(results2_com$log2FoldChange))

table(results1_com_cle$chromosome)
table(results2_com_cle$chromosome)

results1_com_cle <- results1_com_cle %>% mutate(Annotation = if_else(chromosome == "X", "X", "Autosome"))
results2_com_cle <- results2_com_cle %>% mutate(Annotation = if_else(chromosome == "X", "X", "Autosome"))

ggplot(data = results1_com_cle, mapping = aes(x = Annotation, y= log2FoldChange))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08,
              height = 0)+
  labs(title = "Gene Level Expression Changes Following mls2 Knockdown : X Chromosome vs Autosome", x = "Annotation", y= "log2FoldChange")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = results1_com_cle, mapping = aes(x = log2FoldChange, colour = Annotation, fill = Annotation))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1.25, by = 0.25))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, by =2))+
  labs(title = "Distribution of Gene Level Expression Changes Following mls2 Knockdown", x = "log2FoldChange", y =" density")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = results2_com_cle, mapping = aes(x = Annotation, y= log2FoldChange))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08,
              height = 0)+
  labs(title = "Gene Level Expression Changes Following mof Knockdown : X Chromosome vs Autosome", x = "Annotation", y= "log2FoldChange")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = results2_com_cle, mapping = aes(x = log2FoldChange, colour = Annotation, fill = Annotation))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1.25, by = 0.25))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, by =2))+
  labs(title = "Distribution of Gene Level Expression Changes Following mof Knockdown", x = "log2FoldChange", y =" density")+
  theme_minimal() 

aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results1_com_cle, FUN = mean)
aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results2_com_cle, FUN = mean)
aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results1_com_cle, FUN = sd)
aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results2_com_cle, FUN = sd)
aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results1_com_cle, FUN = median)
aggregate(log2FoldChange ~ Annotation, data = results2_com_cle, FUN = median)


```
